title: 高尔夫球
description: 零基础系列课程：从握杆、站姿到推杆，按顺序一集一集学
descriptionEn: A beginner series, from grip and posture through to putting — follow it in order

items.englishName: Lesson 1: Grip, Posture and the Triangle Drill
items.chineseName: 第 1 堂：握杆、站姿、三角形拍球
items.description: 从零开始的第一课：怎么握、怎么站，再用拍球练习找感觉。
items.descriptionEn: The first lesson: how to hold the club, how to stand, and a ball-bouncing drill for feel.

items.description: 先别急着全挥，半挥杆把动作练顺。
items.descriptionEn: Hold off on the full swing — the half swing is what grooves the motion.

items.description: 上杆到位了，下杆才有东西可用。
items.descriptionEn: A complete backswing is what the downswing feeds on.

items.description: 收杆姿势稳不稳，决定球飞得直不直。
items.descriptionEn: A steady finish is what keeps the ball flying straight.

items.description: 力量从哪里来，什么时候放出去。
items.descriptionEn: Where the power comes from, and when to release it.

items.englishName: Lesson 6: Short Game Without the Fat Shot
items.chineseName: 第 6 堂：短杆，远离炒米粉
items.description: 打厚把草皮铲飞（球友戏称炒米粉），怎么避开这个失误。
items.descriptionEn: How to stop hitting fat and tearing up the turf.

items.chineseName: 第 7 堂：把 1 号木变简单
items.description: 一号木不用打得那么复杂。
items.descriptionEn: The driver does not have to be complicated.

items.englishName: Lesson 8: More Distance with the Driver
items.chineseName: 第 8 堂：1 号木打得更远
items.description: 在稳得住的前提下加距离。

items.englishName: Lesson 9: Putting — Where Strokes Are Saved
items.chineseName: 第 9 堂：推杆，赢球的关键
items.description: 一场球里推杆占的杆数最多，练它最划算。
items.descriptionEn: Putting accounts for the most strokes in a round — the best use of practice time.

items.chineseName: 第 10 堂：看懂果岭路线
items.description: 果岭的坡往哪边倒，怎么看出来。
items.descriptionEn: How to read which way a green breaks.

items.chineseName: 第 11 堂：30、50、100 码的距离控制
items.description: 三个常用距离，各用几成力。
items.descriptionEn: Three everyday distances — and how much swing each one needs.
